item.title: Plug 0.4.0
item.description:
• Updates: "Update" downloads the maker's installer and opens it (FabFilter, u-he, Soundtoys), and ejects its disk image when the installer quits: no web browser.
  • Updates: vendor hubs are found wherever they are on your Mac (a Kilohearts Installer in Downloads counts); a missing Kilohearts Installer is downloaded and opened.
  • Updates: the web page is still there: "Website" on each maker, "Open the Download Page" on each row.
